_verified: emulated_roku is another Roku ECP emulator for the Logitech Harmony, the remote fakeroku serves (F-00); fakeroku reads it as a protocol reference only and does not serve Home Assistant. The reference before it, github:logantgt/EcpEmuServer, answered 404 on 2026-11-05 (repository and account gone). 0.5.1 (2026-11-05 against the tag, emulated_roku/__init__.py): SSDP answers an M-SEARCH for `ssdp:all` or `roku:ecp` with `ST: roku:ecp`, a Location and `USN: uuid:roku:ecp:<id>`, and sends `NT: upnp:rootdevice` notifies; HTTP answers GET `/`, `/query/apps`, `/query/icon/<id>`, `/query/device-info`, `/query/active-app` and POST `/keypress/<key>`, `/keydown/<key>`, `/keyup/<key>`, `/launch/<id>`, `/input`, `/search`. fakeroku answers all of it except `/query/active-app`, which stays 404 (K18: only what Harmony and Sofabaton read is answered); its notifies carry `NT: roku:ecp` like a real Roku. Raising this value means reading emulated_roku/__init__.py of the new release (the routes in `_setup_app`, `MULTICAST_RESPONSE`, `MULTICAST_NOTIFY`, `datagram_received`) against src/ecp/ and src/discovery/ again.
